We administered Cre mRNA at a dose of 1.0 mg/kg using cKK-E12 and MC3.
We then quantified the functional delivery of Cre mRNA in vivo using Ai14 reporter mice, 21 which contain cells that fluoresce when Cre mRNA is translated into functional Cre protein.

As a result, cells in these mice only become tdTomato + when Cre mRNA is (i) delivered into the cytoplasm and (ii) translated into Cre protein, which then (iii) translocates into the nucleus and (iv) excises the ‘Stop’ construct from genomic DNA.
Mice were injected intravenously via the lateral tail vein.
